ideas.title: Launch Hats for Fame 🎩
ideas.hook: A model struts down the runway and you fire hats, wigs and shoes at her from a cannon. Whatever lands stays on, and the judges score the outfit.
core_loop: Load your cannon with random clothing pieces
Aim and launch as the model walks past
Pieces that land build her outfit live
Judges score style and a crowd votes
Earn fame to unlock rarer pieces and better cannons
ideas.twist: The round theme (beach, gala, spooky) changes what scores, so a perfect shot with the wrong hat still loses points.
monetization: Extra wardrobe storage for rare pieces
retention: Collect every hat in the catalog
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the top rising mechanic at 2.61 momentum (35 new games, up 0.15 this week), and Hit × Fashion / beauty is the biggest gap in the data (score 4.55). Fashion / beauty is rising at 1.23 with [UPDATE] Barber Simulator (9,482 CCU) and +1 Glow Up Evolution (8,741 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Fashion games style by menu clicks; here you style by aiming a cannon, so skill shots decide the look.

ideas.title: Tornado Yard Sale 🌪️
ideas.hook: Every few minutes a tornado rips through town and dumps random junk in your yard. Grab the good stuff, price it, and sell it to neighbours before the next storm hits.
core_loop: Tornado drops random items on your lot
Sort junk from rare finds
Set prices on your yard sale tables
Customers haggle and buy
Upgrade tables, storm cellar and magnet to pull in better loot
ideas.twist: The tornado can also suck items off your tables, so players tie down valuables or hide them in the cellar before each storm.
retention: Rare storm events (fire tornado, cash tornado)
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Disaster / weather is a top gap (score 4.31). Disaster / weather is the fastest rising theme at 2.06 (up 0.32 this week) with [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (16,580 CCU), and Sell / run a shop sits at 1.31 with Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (18,014 CCU) and Sell a Million Sushi (8,234 CCU).
inspired_by: [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Shop games restock from a menu; here stock arrives by disaster, so every storm is a loot drop and a threat.

ideas.title: Guess the Receipt 🧾
ideas.hook: A shopping cart rolls past packed with random stuff. Everyone guesses the total. Closest guess takes home the cart.
core_loop: A loaded cart rolls into the lobby
Players type their guess for the total
Receipt prints out live, line by line
Closest guess wins the items as cash
Spend cash on carts, emotes and a mansion trophy room
ideas.twist: One player each round is the shopper and secretly fills the cart to fool everyone, scoring if guesses are way off.
monetization: Extra hint pass (one item price revealed)
ideas.why_now: Quiz / guess × Money / rich is a top gap (score 4.09). Money / rich is rising at 1.56 (54 new games) with [🐟] Net a Fish! (30,409 CCU) and [⚡] Steal a Superpower! (16,843 CCU), and quiz games like Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] (2,901 CCU) keep momentum above 1.0 (1.08).
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games ask trivia; this asks a gut-feel price guess, so anyone can win and the shopper role adds bluffing.

ideas.title: +1 Battery Per Jump 🔋
ideas.hook: You are a tiny robot. Every jump adds +1 to your battery, and a bigger battery lets you roll further into the scrapyard where better parts wait.
core_loop: Jump to charge +1 battery each time
Roll out into the scrapyard until power runs out
Grab parts and bolts on the way
Upgrade into bigger robot bodies
Rebirth to unlock new scrapyards (city, volcano, moon)
ideas.twist: Running out of battery leaves you stranded where magnets can drag you back, so players race the drain with risky shortcuts.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is rising at 1.87 (36 new games, spread out) with [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (23,507 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (13,685 CCU), and the "+1 ___" title formula is the top formula at 1.89. +1 × Robots / mechs is an open gap (score 3.34), with robots at 1.58 led by Sweep The Moon 🌕 (16,266 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: +1 games grow a body part; here the stat is fuel, so each run is a push-your-luck trip out and back.

ideas.title: Build a Robot Buddy 🤖
ideas.hook: Draw a robot on a blueprint and it comes to life as your helper. Good drawings make good workers that farm, carry and clean your plot for you.
core_loop: Draw a robot body, arms and wheels on the blueprint
It spawns and starts working your plot
Robots farm crops and haul them to sell
Earn bolts to unlock new parts and colours
Build a crew of robots with different jobs
ideas.twist: The robot copies your drawing for real: long arms reach further, big wheels go faster, so players redesign to fix jobs.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is rising at 1.70 (29 new games, spread out) with ⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (11,027 CCU) and Draw a Flag! in the vision pass, and Paint × Robots / mechs is an open gap (score 3.03). The "Build a ___" formula is up 0.19 this week to 1.14 with Build a Bridge (8,511 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Robot games give you a fixed bot to train; here the robot is your drawing, so every player's crew looks and works differently.

ideas.title: Chisel a Statue 🗿
ideas.hook: A giant rock and a target picture. Chip away with a hammer and chisel to match it, then the judge reveals your % match.
core_loop: Get a target shape (cat, car, famous pose)
Chisel the rock block by block
Reveal your % match score
Sell statues to the museum for cash
Buy better tools, bigger rocks and rare stones
ideas.twist: Hidden gems sit inside some rocks. Carving near them pays big, but one bad hit shatters the gem and the statue.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is up 0.26 this week to 1.15 with Cut a Rock (16,113 CCU), and Paint / create is rising at 1.70. Paint × Stones / rocks / ores is an open gap (score 2.58). The vision pass shows new draw games scoring results with a big % on the thumbnail (Draw a Flag!).
ideas.differentiator: Rock games smash for loot; here breaking is precise, and the result is a statue scored against a target.

ideas.title: Don't Step on the Mine 💣
ideas.hook: Cross a war zone field where some tiles hide mines. Step wrong and you ragdoll sky-high back to the start, while everyone watches you fly.
core_loop: Pick a path across the hidden-mine field
Read clues (cracks, flags, sounds) to stay safe
Get launched as a ragdoll if you guess wrong
Reach the far bunker for cash and medals
Unlock new fields with more mines and tricks
ideas.twist: Every mine you trigger stays marked for other players, so early runners clear the way and later ones race through.
monetization: Mine detector pass (shows one mine per stage)
ideas.why_now: Military / war is up 0.37 this week to 1.27 with Voxel Wars (16,878 CCU) and Ragdoll Wars! (7,339 CCU). Escape / run sits at 1.40 (39 new games) and Hit / swing / launch leads at 2.61, with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (36,700 CCU) showing ragdoll launches pull players. Linear course maps are rising at 1.88.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are open sandboxes; this gives the ragdoll a goal, a field to cross and a shared map other players clear.

ideas.title: Grow Your Own Outfit 🌸
ideas.hook: Plant cotton, silk and glowing flowers, then turn your harvest into dresses, jackets and crowns. What you grow is what you wear.
core_loop: Plant and water fabric crops
Harvest cotton, silk and dye flowers
Weave them into clothing pieces
Wear outfits in the weekly runway show
Sell spare clothes to unlock rare seeds
ideas.twist: Crops mutate with the weather, so a storm can turn plain cotton into a rare glitter fabric that only exists that week.
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm is rising at 1.36 (44 new games, spread out) with [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (15,873 CCU) and [FOREST] Durian Garden 🍈 (9,817 CCU), and Fashion / beauty is up 0.11 to 1.23 with Makeup Salon💄 (7,149 CCU) and +1 Glow Up Evolution (8,741 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Farm games sell crops for cash; here crops become your look, so farming feeds the fashion show players actually care about.

ideas.title: Mine Gems for Rings 💍
ideas.hook: Dig down for raw gems, cut them at your bench, set them into rings and sell them in your jewelry shop. Rarer gems make rings worth millions.
core_loop: Mine deeper layers for rough gems
Cut gems on the polishing wheel
Set them into rings, crowns and necklaces
Sell in your shop to picky customers
Upgrade pickaxe, bench and shop windows
ideas.twist: A bad cut cracks the gem, so rare stones turn into a tense mini-game where steady hands earn the big payout.
ideas.why_now: Break / mine / dig is up 0.26 this week to 1.15 with Cut a Rock (16,113 CCU) and [UPD] Build a REAL House (16,680 CCU). Sell / run a shop sits at 1.31 with [UPDATE] Barber Simulator (9,482 CCU), and Fashion / beauty is rising at 1.23. The "___ for ___" formula is at 1.49 with Bike For Egg! (19,801 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Mining games end at selling ore; here the ore becomes jewelry you craft and price yourself.

ideas.title: Live on the Moon 🌕
ideas.hook: A whole town on the moon. Build your dome house, take a job (miner, rover driver, greenhouse farmer) and keep the colony alive together.
core_loop: Pick a moon job and earn credits
Build and decorate your dome home
Ride rovers between colony zones
Fix air leaks and meteor damage as a team
Unlock new domes, pets and Mars trips
ideas.twist: Oxygen is shared: if the town ignores repairs, the whole server's air drops, so roleplay comes with real teamwork.
ideas.why_now: Space is rising at 1.93 (up 0.34 this week) with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (16,266 CCU) and [MARS] Clean the Moon! (3,329 CCU). Roleplay / life sim × Tycoon / base building is a live pair (11 new games, 48,090 CCU), and Tycoon / base building is up 0.14 to 1.23 with [UPD] Build a REAL House (16,680 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Town roleplays have no stakes; a shared oxygen meter gives the whole server a reason to work together.
